blogs.title: FlashAttention-3 in Plain English: Why It Matters for Faster, Longer-Context Transformers
blogs.description: A high-level tour of why attention is the bottleneck in modern LLMs, what FlashAttention-3 changes compared to earlier versions, and the headline results: 1.5–2.0x FP16 speedups on H100, up to 740 TFLOPs/s utilization, and near-1.2 PFLOPs/s with FP8—plus what that means for training and inference in practice.

blogs.title: Asynchrony on GPUs, Demystified: How Warp Specialization Turbocharges Attention
blogs.description: An accessible explainer of GPU asynchrony on Hopper (Tensor Cores vs TMA), with the producer–consumer model, warp specialization, and register reallocation. Uses analogies and visuals to show how FlashAttention-3 overlaps data movement and compute to hide latency and boost utilization.

blogs.title: Hiding Softmax Under Matmuls: The 2-Stage Pipeline That Makes Attention Fly
blogs.description: Why softmax can be the sleeper bottleneck and how FlashAttention-3 overlaps GEMM and softmax inside and across warpgroups (ping-pong scheduling). Walks through the 2-stage pipeline conceptually, why it works on Hopper, and the trade-offs around register pressure and tile sizes.

blogs.title: FP8, Laid Bare: How FlashAttention-3 Hits Petaflop Speeds Without Losing Its Mind
blogs.description: A practical guide to FP8 attention on H100: layout constraints of FP8 WGMMA, in-kernel transposes with LDSM/STSM, and accumulator-to-operand layout fixes with byte permutes. Explains how these low-level tricks translate to real performance gains developers can feel.

blogs.title: Accuracy at Low Precision: Block Quantization and Incoherent Processing Explained
blogs.description: Why FP8 can struggle with outliers, and how FlashAttention-3 uses block-wise scaling and orthogonal mixing (Hadamard-based) to tame error—achieving 2.6x lower FP8 error than a standard baseline. Includes intuitive examples and where these techniques can be fused in your model pipeline.

blogs.title: Reading the Benchmarks: 740 TFLOPs/s, 1.2 PFLOPs/s FP8, and What That Means for You
blogs.description: A plain-language breakdown of the paper’s results vs. PyTorch, Triton, cuDNN: where FlashAttention-3 wins (and why), the impact of head dimension and causal masking, and how to think about throughput, cost, and energy when choosing FP16 or FP8 for long-context workloads.

blogs.title: From FlashAttention-2 to -3: A Migration Guide for Practitioners
blogs.description: Concrete guidance on adopting FlashAttention-3: supported settings, when to prefer FP16 vs FP8, how sequence length and head dimension affect gains, and what to watch out for (layout assumptions, small-seqlen behavior, causal masks). Includes integration notes for PyTorch and Hugging Face.

blogs.title: Beyond Hopper: The Future of Asynchronous, Low-Precision Attention
blogs.description: A forward-looking piece on how the techniques behind FlashAttention-3 generalize to upcoming accelerators (e.g., FP4 on Blackwell), implications for long-context LLMs and multimodal models, and how open-source kernels can keep pace with evolving hardware.
